title: Claude Designs Proteins, an AI Cancer Vaccine Clears Phase 3, and Robots Learn in One Demo
tldr: Anthropic's Claude ran protein-design campaigns largely on its own, producing working molecules on 14 of 15 targets — AI is reaching into real drug discovery.
Moderna and Merck's AI-designed personalized cancer vaccine cleared a Phase 3 melanoma trial; Moderna stock jumped 177%.
New tip: have ChatGPT Work assemble a daily brief from your calendar, email, and Slack every weekday morning.

tips.heading: Build a daily work brief that assembles itself
steps: In ChatGPT's Work tab, go to Plugins > Connect Plugins and install Google Calendar, Gmail, Slack, and Google Drive.
Run the prompt below to pull meetings, messages, and notes into one brief, then tell ChatGPT what was useful or missing.
Once it works well, schedule it to run every weekday morning and pin the task for quick access.
tips.prompt: Build my daily work brief using [@Google Calendar], [@Gmail], [@Slack], and [@Google Drive]. Review today's meetings, unread messages, follow-ups, and project notes. Summarize my top priorities, meeting prep, replies needed, decisions, important FYIs, and missing context. Do not send messages, edit files, or create tasks.

tips.heading: Fix an inconsistent AI workflow with the Loop Method
steps: Pick a workflow that works unreliably — a skill, project folder, or repeated process.
Run the prompt below (fill in your definition of done), use /goal to assign it a real deliverable, and let it run three review loops.
Test the result; if it still needs work, save the whole thing as a reusable skill you can rerun anytime.
tips.prompt: Improve this workflow in 3 loops. Have a panel of sub-agents adversarially review each loop. Done when [definition of done]

news.body: Anthropic's Claude ran protein-design campaigns largely on its own, a core step in drug discovery. Given one expert prompt plus internet and tools, models Mythos Preview and Opus 4.8 produced working molecules on 14 of 15 targets, hitting 22-35% binding success versus the usual 10-15%. A separate Opus 5 run read raw instrument files with no lab software, measuring a sample at 96.4% pure in 19 minutes, a report the lab took four days to produce. Twist Bioscience and Adaptyv Bio did the lab work.
news.means: Concrete proof autonomous agents are crossing into specialized scientific work — worth citing when advising pharma or R&D clients on where AI can compress timelines.

news.body: Moderna and Merck's AI-designed personalized cancer vaccine cleared a Phase 3 melanoma trial, the first positive late-stage result for an mRNA cancer therapy. Moderna's algorithms sequence a patient's tumor, predict up to 34 mutation targets, and encode a bespoke mRNA vaccine paired with Merck's Keytruda, improving recurrence-free survival. Moderna stock rose 177% and Merck 13%; it could be available by 2027.
news.means: The flagship real-world case of AI in drug discovery — a credible reference point for client talks about AI's value beyond chatbots.

news.body: Generalist's new GEN-1.5 robot model can learn a task from a single 3-to-12-second demonstration held in its context window with zero retraining ("physical prompting"). Across 10 tasks, one demo produced 59% average success, rising to 83% after 10 quick weight updates on five minutes of data.
news.means: The cost and time to teach a robot a task is dropping fast — revisit automation timelines in ops or logistics client work.

beyond_ai.body: US government debt topped $40 trillion this week, up from $19.4 trillion a decade ago, as the Treasury moved to at least double its buybacks of long-term debt. The step pulled 30-year yields back after they hit a 19-year high, easing a bond-market selloff driven by inflation worries.
beyond_ai.angle: Rising long-term yields raise borrowing costs for governments and clients alike — relevant to any budgeting or capital-timing conversation this quarter.
beyond_ai.starter: With 30-year yields near 19-year highs, are any of our clients rethinking the timing of big capital investments?

beyond_ai.body: Amazon plans to expand Prime Air drone delivery to 500 US cities and towns by year's end. Drones carry one package under five pounds within 30 minutes of order, launching first in the Chicago, Cleveland, Atlanta, Boise, and Syracuse areas.
beyond_ai.angle: A concrete last-mile automation milestone to cite with retail or supply-chain clients weighing delivery-speed expectations.
beyond_ai.starter: If 30-minute drone delivery reaches 500 cities, how does that reset customer expectations for the clients we advise?

beyond_ai.body: President Trump paused a threatened 50% tariff on Canadian imports for three days. Goods that would be hit include wine, honey, hockey sticks, and dairy products.
beyond_ai.angle: The on-again-off-again tariff cycle keeps sourcing and pricing assumptions unstable for any client with cross-border supply chains.
beyond_ai.starter: Do any of our clients have exposure to the Canada tariffs, and is there a contingency if the pause lapses in three days?

beyond_ai.body: Astronomers found the Milky Way's fastest known star, S301, clocking up to roughly 56 million mph near the black hole Sagittarius A*. Its tight orbit could let scientists measure the black hole's spin for the first time and test Einstein's theory of relativity.
beyond_ai.angle: No direct relevance to your work, general awareness only.
beyond_ai.starter: They found a star doing 56 million miles an hour — about 100,000 times faster than a passenger jet.

beyond_ai.body: The UAE suspended all trade with Iran after accusing it of firing two ballistic missiles at its territory Tuesday, as Iran's ceasefire with the US frays. The UAE supplied about 30% of Iran's imports, or $22 billion in goods, in 2024.
beyond_ai.angle: Renewed Gulf tension is an oil-price and supply-chain risk worth watching for clients with energy-sensitive costs.
beyond_ai.starter: Gulf tensions are flaring again with the UAE cutting off Iran — worth checking any client exposure to oil-price swings.
